posts.title: First Launching
posts.body:
**Hello and welcome!**

![](/images/uploads/778.jpg)

I am incredibly excited to announce that my personal website, farhanlabib.dpdns.org, is officially launched today **(14-10-2026)**. This has been an amazing learning journey, and I am thrilled to finally share it with all of you.



Please note that this website is currently a *work in progress*. I am continuously working on it, adding new features, improving the design, and making it better every day. You might see some changes happening around here, so please bear with me!



In the coming days, I will be sharing my educational journey, my projects, and my thoughts through this blog.



Thank you so much for visiting and being a part of this journey. Stay tuned for more updates!

aboutText:
## **Hello! I’m Farhan Labib. This is my personal website**.





Education:

My academic journey has been shaped by a strong foundation in Dinajpur, leading me to my current studies in Dhaka.



I continued my higher secondary studies at Ideal Residential Model School, Chirirbandar, Dinajpur, and passed SSC as a proud member of the Class of 2026 (Batch 2K26)



Currently, I am pursuing my higher education at Dhaka College, having started my academic session there on September 24, 2026.
